app.name: Mileage Pocket
home.empty.title: No trips yet
home.empty.message: Press START when you set off. Your first mileage record is one tap away.
activity.title: Trip in progress
summary.title: Trip saved
trips.empty.title: No trips to show
trips.empty.message: Trips you record appear here, newest first. You can also add one by hand.
detail.edit.distance.message: The recorded distance is kept. The amount is recalculated with the rate already applied to this trip.
detail.recalculate.message: This replaces the rate saved with this trip by the one in force today. Older trips normally keep the rate that applied when you drove them.
manual.title: Add a trip
reports.empty.hint: No business trips in this period yet. The report will be empty.
vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.empty.title: No vehicle yet
vehicles.empty.message: Add the car you drive for work. You can record trips without one, but reports read better with it.
vehicle.name: Name
vehicle.fiscal.horsepower.help: Your country's mileage scale uses fiscal horsepower. It is printed on your registration document.
vehicle.engine.capacity.help: Your country's mileage scale uses engine capacity. It is printed on your registration document.
settings.name: Name
settings.no.official.rule: Mileage Pocket has no verified official scale for this country, so your own rate is used. Tracking, history and reports work exactly the same.
settings.delete.all.message: Every trip, vehicle and client is removed from this iPhone and from iCloud. This cannot be undone.
paywall.headline: Your mileage. Automatically documented.
onboarding.welcome.headline: Track every business mile.
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: Start your trip. Drive. Stop. Your mileage report is ready.
onboarding.country.title: Your country
onboarding.country.subtitle: This sets your currency, your units and the mileage rule applied to your trips.
onboarding.country.official: An official mileage scale is built in for %@.
onboarding.country.custom: No official scale is built in for this country. You will set your own rate, and everything else works the same.
onboarding.vehicle.title: Your vehicle
onboarding.vehicle.subtitle: Only what your country's mileage rule actually needs.
onboarding.location.title: Let Mileage Pocket track your drives
onboarding.location.subtitle: Location access lets the app calculate your mileage even when your iPhone is locked.
onboarding.location.detail: Your positions stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. They are never sold, shared or sent to an advertiser.
onboarding.notifications.title: Stay on top of your trips
onboarding.notifications.subtitle: A reminder if a trip is still running, and a nudge when your monthly report is worth generating.
notification.trip.running.title: Trip still running
notification.trip.running.body: Mileage Pocket has been recording for three hours. Stop the trip if you have arrived.
notification.trip.saved.title: Trip saved
notification.report.title: Your monthly report is ready to generate
notification.report.body: Last month's business trips are in. Export the PDF while it is fresh.
settings.icloud.unavailable: iCloud sync is not available in this build. Your trips are stored on this iPhone.
home.location.refused.title: Location is off
home.location.refused.message: Mileage Pocket cannot measure a trip without location access. Turn it on in Settings to start recording.
summary.discard.title: Discard this trip?
summary.discard.message: The distance you just drove will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
detail.delete.title: Delete this trip?
detail.delete.message: This trip and its route are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
settings.export.all.note: A complete archive of your records, in a machine-readable format. Formatted PDF and CSV reports are part of the subscription.
export.failed.title: Export failed
export.failed.message: The file could not be written. Free up some space on your iPhone and try again.
